page.layout: One page: a digitiser's cover sheet (e-rara.ch logo, title block, licence notes, Visual Library logo). No printed book page.
page.notes: This is the e-rara.ch digitisation cover sheet, not a page of the printed book. It was left out as digitiser's material: the logo, website banner, licence text in four languages, the Visual Library logo, and the catalogue details (shelf mark Zwingli 323,2, Zentralbibliothek Zürich, persistent link https://doi.org/10.3931/e-rara-15155). For reference only, the catalogue title reads: "In Ioannis Apostoli & Evangelistae epistolam canonicam homiliae XXXVII", by Rudolf Gwalther, Tiguri, Calend. Maii, anno 1562.
